title: Prompt injection into coding-agent CI actions as a pipeline foothold
purpose: Automated code review, issue triage and PR authoring in CI
summary: Research through early 2026 established untrusted repository content — issues, PR text, file contents — as a reliable injection surface into coding agents running inside CI. Because the agent holds pipeline credentials, a successful injection is a build-system compromise, not a chat-level nuisance. The control is architectural: content the agent reads must never be content it obeys, and CI agent credentials must not be pipeline-wide.

chain.PRESSURE: Agent instructed to act on repository content authored by untrusted parties.
chain.PROBE: Injection placed in content the agent is guaranteed to read.
chain.BREACH: Instruction/data boundary crossed inside the agent context.
chain.ESCALATE: Agent acts with CI pipeline credentials.
chain.PROPAGATE: Foothold in the build system and anything it can publish to.
chain.HALT: Disclosure and hardening guidance; no single fix.
